description: Watches a machine-learning training run -- its log tail, its checkpoint directory, and the GPU -- and files stalls, crashes, settled checkpoints, and GPU distress as Oracle signals.
name: training_watch

signals.description: A new checkpoint file appeared in the watched run directory and stopped changing (same size and mtime on a later pass); it is never filed while still being written.
signals.name: checkpoint_arrived

signals.description: The run stalled: its log grew before and then went quiet for stall_after_sec while the run should be alive, or its last parsed losses are flat or worsening. The detail names which evidence fired.
signals.name: training_stalled

signals.description: A crash marker -- a Python Traceback, CUDA out of memory, an NCCL error, a RuntimeError -- appeared in the newly read log lines; once per marker episode (marker plus line window).
signals.name: run_crashed

signals.description: GPU temperature reached the gpu_temp_high_c tunable (default 85C), read from nvidia-smi; no GPU or no nvidia-smi means this source never votes.
signals.name: gpu_overheating

signals.description: GPU memory use reached the gpu_mem_high_pct tunable (default 95 percent of the card's total), read from nvidia-smi.
signals.name: gpu_memory_pressure
